sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Stick War: Hero Tower Defense is a tower defense game where players must strategically place and upgrade their stickman heroes to defeat incoming enemies. The game features a wide range of enemies, each with their unique strengths, weaknesses, and abilities. As players progress through the levels, they'll encounter increasingly difficult enemies, each requiring a different strategy to defeat.

The game's core mechanics include resource management, enemy placement, and upgrading your stickman heroes. Players must collect gold coins and resources to upgrade their heroes, unlock new abilities, and purchase upgrades for their base. The game also features a variety of power-ups and special abilities that can be used to gain an advantage over the enemy.

One of the game's standout features is its intuitive controls, which allow players to use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to navigate the game world.
